sentences.en: A Many procedures are available for obtaining data about a language.
sentences.zh: 有许多程序可以获取有关一种语言的数据。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They range from a carefully planned, intensive field investigation in a foreign country to a casual introspection about one’s mother tongue carried out in an armchair at home.
sentences.zh: 调查范围从精心策划、在外国进行密集的实地调查到在家里用扶手椅对母语进行临时反省。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B In all cases, someone has to act as a source of language data — an informant.
sentences.zh: B 在所有情况下,都必须有人充当语言数据的来源——线人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Informants are (ideally) native speakers of a language, who provide utterances for analysis and other kinds of information about the language (e.g. translations, comments about correctness, or judgments on usage).
sentences.zh: 知情人(理想地)是语言的本地语言使用者,他们提供语言分析和其他信息(如翻译、正确性评论或使用判断)的讲稿。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Often, when studying their mother tongue, linguists act as their own informants, judging the ambiguity, acceptability, or other properties of utterances against their own intuitions.
sentences.zh: 语言学家在学习母语时,往往充当自己的线人,根据自己的直觉判断言论的模糊性、可接受性或其他特性。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The convenience of this approach makes it widely used, and it is considered the norm in the generative approach to linguistics.
sentences.zh: 这种方法的方便性使它得到广泛使用,并被认为是语言传教方法的规范。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But a linguist’s personal judgments are often uncertain, or disagree with the judgments of other linguists, at which point recourse is needed to more objective methods of enquiry, using non-linguists as informants.
sentences.zh: 但语言学家的个人判断往往不确定,或与其他语言学家的判决不相符,因此需要利用非语言学家作为线人,采用更客观的调查方法。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The latter procedure is unavoidable when working on foreign languages, or child speech.
sentences.zh: 后一种程序在讲外语或儿童演讲时是不可避免的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: C Many factors must be considered when selecting informants – whether one is working with single speakers (a common situation when language has not been described before), two people interacting small groups or large-scale samples.
sentences.zh: C 选择线人时必须考虑许多因素, 无论是与单一发言人合作(通常情况下语言没有描述)、两人交流小群体或大规模抽样。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Age, sex, social background and other aspects of identity are important, as these factors are known to influence the kind of language used.
sentences.zh: 年龄、性别、社会背景和身份的其他方面很重要,因为众所周知,这些因素影响所使用的语言。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The topic of conversation and the characteristics of the social setting (e.g. the level of formality) are also highly relevant, as are the personal qualities of the informants (e.g. their fluency and consistency).
sentences.zh: 谈话的主题和社会环境的特点(如形式程度)也具有高度的相关性,线人的个人素质(如其流利和一致性)也是如此。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For large studies, scrupulous attention has been paid to the sampling theory employed, and in all cases, decisions have to be made about the best investigative techniques to use.
sentences.zh: 对于大型研究,已认真注意所采用的抽样理论,而且在所有情况下,都必须就最佳调查技术的使用作出决定。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D Today, researchers often tape-record informants.
sentences.zh: 今天,研究人员经常通过录音向线人提供情报

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This enables the linguist’s claims about the language to be checked, and provides a way of making those claims more accurate (“difficult” pieces of speech can be listened to repeatedly).
sentences.zh: 这使语言学家关于语言的说法能够得到核实,并提供了一种使这些说法更加准确的方式( " 难以理解的 " 语言可以反复听到)。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But obtaining naturalistic, good-quality data is never easy.
sentences.zh: 但是,获得自然、优质的数据从来不容易。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: People talk abnormally when they know they are being recorded, and sound quality can be poor.
sentences.zh: 人们知道自己被记录下来时会反常地说话,而且声音质量可能很差。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: A variety of tape-recording procedures have thus been devised to minimize the “observer’s paradox” (how to observe the way people behave when they are not being observed).
sentences.zh: 因此,设计了各种录音程序,以尽量减少 " 观察者悖论 " (如何观察人们在不受观察时的行为方式)。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Some recordings are made without the speakers being aware of the facta procedure that obtains very natural data, though ethical objections must be anticipated.
sentences.zh: 有些录音是在发言者不知道获得非常自然数据的事实程序的情况下录制的,尽管必须预先提出道德上的反对意见。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Alternatively, attempts can be made to make the speaker forget about the recording, such as keeping the tape recorder out of sight, or using radio microphones.
sentences.zh: 或者,也可以试图使发言者忘记录音,例如不让录音机在视线外,或使用无线电麦克风。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 发言者发言者发言者发言者发言者

sentences.en: A useful technique is to introduce a topic that quickly involves the speaker, and stimulates a natural language style (e.g. asking older informants about how times have changed in their locality).
sentences.zh: 一种有用的方法是,引进一个迅速涉及发言者的专题,并激发一种自然的语言风格(例如,询问老的线人,他们所在的地方时间的变化)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E An audio tape recording does not solve all the linguist’s problems, however.
sentences.zh: 语言学家的问题都无法解决。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Speech is often unclear and ambiguous.
sentences.zh: 发言往往不明确和含糊不清。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Where possible, therefore, the recording has to be supplemented by the observer’s written comments on the non-verbal behavior of the participants, and about the context in general.
sentences.zh: 因此,在可能的情况下,记录必须辅之以观察员关于参加者非口头行为和一般背景的书面评论。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: A facial expression, for example, can dramatically alter the meaning of what is said.
sentences.zh: 例如面部表情能够显著改变所说的话的含义

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Video recordings avoid these problems to a large extent, but even they have limitations (the camera cannot be everywhere), and transcriptions always benefit from any additional commentary provided by an observer.
sentences.zh: 录像录像在很大程度上避免了这些问题,但即使有限制(摄影机不可能到处都有),记录总是得益于观察员提供的任何补充评注。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: F Linguists also make great use of structured sessions, in which they systematically ask their informants for utterances that describe certain actions, objects or behaviour.
sentences.zh: F语言学家还充分利用有条理的会议,在会议上他们系统地要求其线人发表描述某些行动、目标或行为的言论。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: With a bilingual informant, or through use of an interpreter, it is possible to use translation techniques (‘How do you say table in your language?’).
sentences.zh: 使用双语线人,或使用口译,可以使用翻译技术(`如何用你的语言说表格? ' )。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A large number of points can be covered in a short time, using interview worksheets and questionnaires.
sentences.zh: 使用访谈工作表和问卷,可以在短期内涵盖大量要点。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Often, the researcher wishes to obtain information about just s single variable, in which case a restricted set of questions may be used a particular feature of pronunciation, for example, can be elicited by asking the informant to say a restricted set of words.
sentences.zh: 研究人员往往希望获得关于单一变量的信息,在这种情况下,可以使用一组有限的问题,例如,通过要求线人说一套限制性的词,可以引出发音的一个特定特征。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: There are also several direct methods of elicitation, such as asking informants to fill in the blanks in a substitution frame (e.g. I___ see a car), or feeding them the wrong stimulus of correction (‘is it possible to say I no can see?’)
sentences.zh: 还有几种直接的诱导方法,例如要求线人填写替代框架的空白(例如I___看到车),或给他们错误的纠正刺激(`能否说看不到? ' )

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: G A representative sample of language, compiled for the purpose of linguistic analysis, is known as a corpus.
sentences.zh: G 为语言分析目的汇编的具有代表性的语言样本称为 " 文体 " 。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: A corpus enables the linguist to make unbiased statements about frequency of usage, and it provides accessible data for the use of different researchers.
sentences.zh: 一项保护令使语言学家能够就使用频率作出不偏袒的陈述,并提供可获取的数据供不同研究人员使用。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Its range and size are variable.
sentences.zh: 其范围与大小各不相同。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Some corpora attempt to cover the language as a whole, taking extracts from many kinds of text, others are extremely selective, providing a collection of material that deals only with a particular linguistic feature.
sentences.zh: 一些公司试图将整个语文包括在内,从多种文本中摘录,另一些则极为选择性,提供只涉及特定语言特征的材料汇编。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The size of the corpus depends on practical factors, such as the time available to collect, process and store the data it can take up to several hours to provide an accurate transcription of a few minutes of speech.
sentences.zh: 保护令的大小取决于实际因素,例如收集、处理和储存数据的时间,它需要几个小时才能准确记录几分钟的发言稿。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Sometimes a small sample of data will be enough to decide a linguistic hypothesis; by contrast, corpora in major research projects can total millions of words.
sentences.zh: 有时,少量抽样数据将足以决定语言假设;相反,主要研究项目中的公司可以总共用上百万字。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: An important principle is that all corpora, whatever their size, are inevitably limited in their coverage, and always need to be supplemented by data derived from the intuitions of native speakers of the language, through either introspection or experimentation.
sentences.zh: 一项重要原则是,所有社团,无论大小,其覆盖范围不可避免地受到限制,而且始终需要通过反省或实验,用当地语言使用者直觉得出的数据加以补充。
